# nepui

> nepui is a lightweight ui component library providing accessible, customizable components for HTML/CSS/JavaScript and React.

## Documentation

* [Documentation](https://nepui.vercel.app/docs)
* [Components](https://nepui.vercel.app/docs/components)
* [CLI](https://nepui.vercel.app/docs/cli)
* [Changelog](https://nepui.vercel.app/docs/changelog)

## Components

### HTML

* [Button](https://nepui.vercel.app/docs/components/html/button): A button triggers an action, submits a form, or performs another user-initiated operation.
* [Spinner](https://nepui.vercel.app/docs/components/html/spinner): An indicator that can be used to show a loading state.

### React

* [Button](https://nepui.vercel.app/docs/components/react/button): A button triggers an action, submits a form, or performs another user-initiated operation.
* [Spinner](https://nepui.vercel.app/docs/components/react/spinner): An indicator that can be used to show a loading state.

## Supported Targets

* HTML — Components use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript where required.
* React — Components are provided as React components with TypeScript and CSS.

## Installation

### HTML

HTML components can be copied directly from their documentation or fetched from the HTML registry.

```bash
npx nepui add button --target html
npx nepui add spinner --target html
```

### React

React components can be added using the nepui CLI.

```bash
npx nepui add button --target react
npx nepui add spinner --target react
```

## Registry

The component registry provides machine-readable component definitions.

* HTML registry index: `https://nepui.vercel.app/r/html/registry.json`
* React registry index: `https://nepui.vercel.app/r/react/registry.json`

* HTML registry: `https://nepui.vercel.app/r/html/<component>.json`
* React registry: `https://nepui.vercel.app/r/react/<component>.json`


## CLI

nepui provides a CLI for adding components to a project.

```bash
npx nepui add <component> --target <html|react>
```

**Default target: `html`**

Examples:

```bash
npx nepui add button
npx nepui add button --target react
npx nepui add spinner
npx nepui add spinner --target react
```
